questions.question:
If + means - , - means x , x means ÷ , ÷ means +, then what will come in place of the question mark (?) in the following equation?

23 - 15 ÷ 246 + 318 x 6 = ?
questions.solution:
BODMAS Rule:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9af04f35bab67ce1b4616e5c55030e4c661f0cac806de56579e265e6b6aa2188.png] 

Decoding the given information:

 
 

 
 
**Symbol**

 
 
 
+

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 

 
 
**Meaning**

 
 
 
-

 
 
 
×

 
 
 
÷

 
 
 
+

 
 
 

Given equation: 23 - 15 ÷ 246 + 318 x 6 = ?

Now replacing the sign from left to right using BODMAS Rule, we get:

⇒ 23 × 15 + 246 − __**318 ÷ 6**__ = ?
⇒ __**23 × 15**__ + 246 − 53 = ?
⇒ __**345 + 246**__ − 53 = ?
⇒ __**591 − 53**__ = ?
⇒ 538 = ?

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All kites are banks.

No pencils are kites.

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some banks are not pencils.

(II) All banks are kites.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All kites are banks.

No pencils are kites.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a5d872400bb9c0c9a0dd8eb57d9e093b520d5f2fcc4f56ad793986634dda207a.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) Some banks are not pencils. - **Follow **(Because, all kites are banks and no pencils are kites, which means the banks being kites are not pencils.)

(II) All banks are kites. - Does not follow (Because, all kites are banks does not mean all banks are kites, it means some banks are kites.)

Thus, only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 2**".

questions.question:
What will come in the place of the question mark (?) in the following equation, if ‘+’ and ‘−’ are interchanged and ‘×’ and ‘÷’ are interchanged?

 34 - 7 div 6 + 270 times 9 = ?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Interchange signs: (− → +), (÷ → ×), (+ → −), (× → ÷).

New expression: 34 + 7 × 6 − 270 ÷ 9

Using BODMAS: 34 + 42 − 30

Final value: 76 − 30 = 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given equation: 34 − 7 ÷ 6 + 270 × 9 = ?

Rule: Interchange (+) with (−) and (×) with (÷).

⇒ Modified equation: 34 + 7 × 6 − 270 ÷ 9

⇒ 34 + 7 × 6 − (270 ÷ 9)

⇒ 34 + 7 × 6 − 30

⇒ 34 + (7 × 6) − 30

⇒ 34 + 42 − 30

⇒ 76 − 30

⇒ 46

**∴ The correct answer is 46.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

BODMAS Rule

Simplification always follows the sequence: Brackets, Orders, Division, Multiplication, Addition, and then Subtraction.

Sign Interchange Method

In logical reasoning, ensure all pairs of signs are swapped simultaneously before initiating the calculation to prevent BODMAS errors.</p

questions.question: Deepali ranked 9th from the top and 43rd from the bottom in her class. How many students are there in the class?
questions.solution:
**Given: **Deepali ranked 9th from the top and 43rd from the bottom in her class.

Total students = Rank from top + Rank from bottom − 1

Total students = 9 + 43 − 1

= 52 − 1

= 51

Thus, there are 51 students in the class.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

All golds are hens.

No hen is a cow.

**Conclusions:**

(I) No gold is a cow.

(II) Some cows are hens.
questions.solution:
**Statements:**

All golds are hens.

No hen is a cow.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/76f40ea1a6eb2c0741827699483be30cb6ca6688c4ca5927335b4cad1de0cb09.png] 

**Conclusions:**

(I) No gold is a cow. - Follow (Because, all golds are hens and no hen is a cow, which means no gold is a cow.)

(II) Some cows are hens. - Does not follow (Because, no hen is a cow, so some cows are not hens.)

Thus, only conclusion (I) follows.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(Note: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(11, 110, 10)

(8, 64, 8)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

**Logic: **(a, b, c) → a × c = b

11 × 10 = 110

8 × 8 = 64

Let's check each option:

 
• 
 
(12, 120, 10) → 12 × 10 = 120

 
 
• 
 
(7, 56, 7) → 7 × 7 = 49 ≠ 56

 
 
• 
 
(9, 72, 9) → 9 × 9 = 81 ≠ 72

 
 
• 
 
(10, 80, 9) → 10 × 9 = 90 ≠ 80

 

Thus, (12, 120, 10) is the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as the given sets.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 1**".
